parent.intent: Combine the parent's progress-modulated return-to-start weighting with a regret term that is stronger early in the tour (to avoid myopic local choices that create poor long-term structure, especially in uniform instances) and weaker late (when the adaptive return weight dominates to focus on tour closure). This adds look-ahead diversity without disturbing the return-aware core.
parent.code:
def priority(f):
    d = f["distance"]
    r = f["return_distance"]
    g = f["regret"]
    p = f["progress"]
    return -d + (0.15 + 0.4 * p) * r + (0.25 - 0.15 * p) * g
